home.title: Every photo from your event, finally together.
home.subtitle: Your guests scan a QR code and share their photos and videos. No app, no account. You find everything in a single album.
home.ctaHint: Free, ready in under a minute.

demoBand.text: A full demo, no account needed: pick sample photos, watch them go, cut the network to see what happens. Nothing is sent.

home.pricingSubtitle: Free to start, the Event plan when you need it.
home.pricingProNote: A Pro plan for photographers and venues is planned; it is not available yet.
home.usesSubtitle: Practical advice for getting the album of your event right.

uses.wedding: A QR code on every table, a slideshow at the reception, every photo your guests took.
uses.birthday: One link to share, photos and short videos from every guest, an album that lasts.
uses.corporate: Seminar, team party, trade show: photos approved before they are shown.

app.q: Do my guests need to install an app or create an account?
app.a: No. They scan the QR code, the page opens in their browser and they send their photos. No app, no account, no password.

network.q: What if the signal is bad during the party?
network.a: Each photo a guest picks waits on their phone until it has safely arrived. If the connection drops, the upload picks up again when the network is back, and if the guest closes the page, they find their pending uploads when they reopen it. The safest way is still to keep the page open until the upload is done.

limits.q: How many photos and videos can be sent?
limits.a: The free plan accepts {freeMedia} photos and videos per event, including up to {freeVideos} videos of {freeVideoDuration} at most. The Event plan goes up to {eventMedia} (fair use), with videos of {eventVideoDuration} at most. The number of guests is not limited.

quality.q: Are photos kept in full quality?
quality.a: On the free plan, photos are kept as optimised versions ({px} px at most): originals are not kept. On the Event plan, originals are kept for photos sent after you switch to it; photos sent before stay optimised.

retention.q: How long is the album kept?
retention.a: {freeDays} days after the event on the free plan, {eventMonths} months on the Event plan. Before the end, you get e-mail reminders with a link to download everything, and you can extend by {extensionMonths} months for {extensionPrice}.

privacy.a: Only people who have the event’s QR code or link, and only if you open the gallery to guests. You can also approve each photo before it appears, hide or delete a photo, and block a guest.

download.q: Can I download all the photos?
download.a: Yes, as one or more ZIP files from your dashboard: original photos on the Event plan, optimised photos on the free plan.

guestDelete.q: Can a guest remove a photo they sent?
guestDelete.a: Yes. From “My photos”, each guest can delete their own photos and videos at any time.

refund.a: Yes, within {days} days if fewer than {max} photos were sent. Payment is secured by Stripe: no card data goes through {appName}.

pro.q: I’m a photographer or a venue: is there a plan for me?
pro.a: A Pro plan (white label, several events at once) is planned. It is not available yet.

wedding.metaTitle: Shared wedding photo album with a QR code
wedding.metaDescription: Collect the photos and videos of all your guests after the wedding: a QR code on every table, a single album, no app or account.
wedding.title: Every photo of your wedding, not only the photographer’s
wedding.intro: The photographer tells the story of the day, your guests tell the story of the party: the cousins’ table in fits of laughter, grandma on the dance floor, the cocktail hour behind the scenes. A QR code is all it takes for everything to land in one album.
wedding.pointsTitle: Why it works for a wedding

a.title: A QR code on every table
a.text: Print A6 or A5 cards, or a foldable table tent: each guest scans without installing anything, from the entrance to the last dance.

b.title: All ages, two taps
b.text: Scan, pick your photos. The page is designed for the guests who are least comfortable with technology: big buttons, short texts.

c.title: The slideshow at the reception
c.text: Project the album live on a screen: photos arrive through the evening, after the approval step you have chosen.

wedding.planText: The free plan accepts {freeMedia} photos and videos: with many guests, that quota can be reached quickly. The Event plan ({eventPrice}, one-off) goes up to {eventMedia} (fair use), keeps the album for {eventMonths} months and keeps original photos. It is better to take it before the party: originals are only kept for photos sent after you switch to this plan.

tips.a: Put a QR code at the entrance and on every table, with a simple line: “Send us your photos”.
tips.b: Mention it in the programme or over the microphone during dinner: one line is enough.
tips.c: Connect a computer to the room’s screen and start the live slideshow: the screen stays on and a QR code stays visible in a corner.
tips.d: After the party, mark the album as ready: guests who left their address receive the link.

birthday.metaTitle: Shared birthday photo album: one link, every photo
birthday.metaDescription: Bring the photos and videos of the party together in one album: your guests upload from their phone, no app or account.
birthday.title: One birthday, dozens of phones, a single album
birthday.intro: The cake, the candles, the surprise: everyone takes pictures on their own, and they stay buried in their phones. With one link to share, you get them all in the same place.
birthday.pointsTitle: Why it works for a birthday

a.title: One link, nothing to print
a.text: Send the link to your group chat or show the QR code next to the cake: everyone can join in, no account needed.

b.title: Photos and short videos
b.text: Your guests send their videos too: up to {freeVideos} videos of {freeVideoDuration} at most on the free plan.

c.title: An album that lasts
c.text: After the party, everything is in one album you can download as ZIP files, and that your guests can revisit with the same link.

birthday.planText: For a party with friends or family, the free plan ({freeMedia} photos and videos, album kept {freeDays} days after the event) is often enough. If the album fills up, you switch to the Event plan ({eventPrice}): uploads left waiting on phones go through by themselves.

tips.a: Share the link before the party, so everyone knows where to send their photos.
tips.b: Print an A6 card with the QR code and put it next to the cake.
tips.c: For a surprise, keep the gallery closed to guests until the right moment: they can upload without seeing each other’s photos.
tips.d: Download the album before the end of the retention period: you get reminders by e-mail.

corporate.metaTitle: Photo album for company events: seminars, parties, trade shows
corporate.metaDescription: Collect your attendees’ photos with a QR code, approve them before they are shown and stay in control of the album. No app or account.
corporate.title: Photos of your company events, approved before they are shown
corporate.intro: Seminar, team party, trade show, opening: attendees take photos, you stay in control of what is displayed and kept.
corporate.pointsTitle: Why it works for a company

a.title: No account to create
a.text: Attendees scan and send: no app and no sign-up, so nothing gets in the way on the day.

b.title: Approval before display
b.text: Turn on prior approval: a photo only appears in the album and on the slideshow once you agree, one by one, with the keyboard.

c.title: Moderation and blocking
c.text: Hide or delete a photo, handle reports, block a guest: everything is done from the moderation page.

corporate.planText: For a one-off event, the Event plan ({eventPrice}) keeps originals for {eventMonths} months, with a discreet “Made with {appName}” mention. If you run events all year or for clients, a Pro plan (white label, several events) is planned; it is not available yet.

tips.a: Decide before the day who approves the photos.
tips.b: Show the QR code on the welcome screen and on printed material: the live slideshow keeps one on screen all the time.
tips.c: Tell attendees that their photos will be visible to the other guests of the event.
tips.d: Download and archive the album before the end of the retention period: deletion is final afterwards.

common.draftBody: This text has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer. It describes how the service works today and may change before it opens to the public.

notice.metaDescription: Publisher, hosts and contact of the {appName} service.
notice.title: Legal notice

publisher.title: Publisher of the service
paragraphs: The {appName} service is published by {company}, {legalForm}, registered under SIRET number {siret}, whose registered office is at {address}.
Publication director: {director}.
Contact: {contact}.

hosting.title: Hosting
paragraphs: The website and the application are hosted by Vercel Inc. ({hostAddress}).
Photos and videos are stored with Cloudflare (R2 service). The database and authentication are provided by Supabase. These providers, their role and their location are detailed in the privacy policy.

content.title: Guests’ content
paragraphs: The photos and videos of an event are sent by its guests. The organiser of the event is responsible for the album and for the people they invite to take part; each guest is responsible for what they send.

Content that is clearly unlawful, or that infringes someone’s privacy, can be reported from the album viewer (“Report” button) or by e-mail to the contact address above. It will be reviewed and removed if necessary.

ip.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: The {appName} name, the logo, the texts and the graphics of the site are protected. Any reproduction without permission is forbidden.
Photos and videos sent by guests remain their property; the rights of use granted to the service are described in the terms of use.

terms.metaDescription: The rules for using {appName}, for organisers and for guests.
terms.title: Terms of use

purpose.title: What these terms are for
paragraphs: {appName} lets the organiser of an event gather, in a shared album, the photos and videos sent by their guests from their phones, with a QR code, with no app and no account for guests.

These terms apply to anyone who uses the service: the organiser, who creates the event with an account, and the guest, who takes part without an account. By using the service you accept them; a guest accepts them by ticking the box when joining.

organiser.title: The organiser
paragraphs: The organiser creates their account with their e-mail address (sign-in link or Google account). They are responsible for their account and their event.

They decide who can take part, whether the gallery is opened to guests, whether photos must be approved first and whether a guest is blocked. They agree to tell the people they invite that their photos and videos will be visible to them and, if they open the gallery, to the other guests.

guest.title: The guest
paragraphs: A guest can send photos and videos to the event they reached through the QR code or the link. They may give a first name, which is optional and is shown to the organiser next to their photos.
A guest can delete their own photos and videos at any time from “My photos”.

rules.title: What you send
paragraphs: You must only send content you have the right to share. The following is forbidden:
items: unlawful, violent or hateful content, or sexual content shared without consent;
content that infringes someone’s privacy, image or rights;
files that are not photos or videos, and anything meant to disrupt the service.

licence.title: Your rights over your content
paragraphs: You remain the owner of your photos and videos. You grant the organiser and {appName} the right to store them, to prepare reduced versions, to show them in the event’s album, slideshow and sharing pages, and to make them downloadable, only for the retention period of the event and to run the service.

For the same purpose, display versions and thumbnails are created without GPS coordinates. Original files, kept with the paid plan, stay as you sent them and may contain their metadata, including location.

moderation.title: Moderation and reporting
paragraphs: The organiser can hide, refuse or delete content and block a guest. Any guest can report content. {appName} may remove content, or suspend an event or an account, if these terms or the law are breached.

availability.title: Availability and retention
paragraphs: The service is provided as is, with no guarantee of permanent availability. Albums are kept {freeDays} days after the event on the free plan and {eventMonths} months on the Event plan, then permanently deleted, with e-mail reminders to the organiser before the album closes and seven days to recover an expired album by extending it.
We advise you to download the album before the end of the retention period: a deletion is final.

liability.title: Liability
paragraphs: {appName} uses reasonable means to protect and keep your content, but cannot guarantee that nothing will be lost. We cannot be held liable for content sent by guests; our liability is limited to the extent the law allows.
[To be validated by a lawyer: limitation of liability, clauses applying to consumers.]

changes.title: Changes to the terms and applicable law
paragraphs: These terms may change; the version in force is the one on this page. They are governed by French law. In case of a dispute, {court} has jurisdiction, subject to the rules protecting consumers.

sales.metaDescription: Prices, payment, duration and refunds for {appName}’s paid plans.
sales.title: Terms of sale

seller.title: Seller
paragraphs: The paid plans are sold by {company}, {legalForm}, SIRET {siret}, {address}. Contact: {contact}. VAT number: {vatNumber}.

offers.title: Plans and prices
paragraphs: The service offers a free plan and paid options, bought one at a time, with no subscription:
items: the Event plan: {eventPrice} including VAT per event, with up to {eventMedia} photos and videos (fair use), original photos kept for uploads made after the purchase and the album kept for {eventMonths} months;
the extension: {extensionPrice} including VAT for {extensionMonths} more months of retention.

pro.title: Pro plan
paragraphs: A Pro plan for professionals is planned; it is not on sale yet. Its terms will be published when it launches.

payment.title: Payment
paragraphs: Payment is made online, by card, on Stripe’s secure page: no card data goes through {appName}. Prices are in euros, all taxes included. Stripe sends an invoice to the buyer’s e-mail address.

The plan applies as soon as payment is confirmed: the event’s limits are raised immediately. The Event plan can be bought before, during or after the event. Originals are only kept for photos sent after the purchase.

withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
paragraphs: [To be validated by a lawyer: the digital service is provided immediately after purchase; the consumer must expressly agree and acknowledge losing the right of withdrawal once the service is performed. Provide the matching checkbox at payment.]

refund.title: Refunds
paragraphs: As a goodwill gesture, the Event plan is refunded on request within {refundDays} days of purchase if fewer than {refundMax} photos and videos have been sent to the event. Write to us at {contact}. The refund goes back to the payment method used; the event then returns to the free plan and content already sent is not deleted because of the quota.

expiry.title: End of retention
paragraphs: At the end of the retention period, the album is closed to guests and permanently deleted seven days later. During those seven days, buying the Event plan or an extension brings it back. Reminders are sent to the organiser before it closes.

disputes.title: Complaints and disputes
paragraphs: For any complaint, write to {contact}. Consumers may use a consumer mediator free of charge: {mediator}.
These terms are governed by French law. {court} has jurisdiction, subject to the rules protecting consumers.

privacy.metaDescription: What data {appName} collects, why, for how long, and how to exercise your rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy

controller.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: For account, sign-in and payment data, the data controller is {company} ({address}), contact: {contact}.

For the photos and videos of an event, the organiser decides how they are used; {appName} hosts them on the organiser’s behalf to run the service. [To be validated by a lawyer: roles of {appName}, the organiser and the guests.]

data.title: The data we process
paragraphs: Depending on how you use the service:
items: organiser: e-mail address, optional display name, language, events created and their settings, purchases (Stripe payment identifiers, amount, event title);

sign-in: a single-use token sent by e-mail, and a fingerprint (SHA-256) of the IP address kept for 15 minutes to limit abuse; with Google, the Google identity (e-mail, name); Cloudflare Turnstile anti-bot check on the link request;

guest: an anonymous identifier created when joining, the optional first name, the date the terms were accepted, their photos and videos; an e-mail address only if the guest asks to be told when the album is ready, with a separate consent;
photos and videos: the original file with the paid plan, a display version and a thumbnail without GPS coordinates, the date taken and the author (guest);
reports: a salted hash of the session or address of the person reporting, never their identity;
technical logs: errors (Sentry, with no personal data), the log of automatic e-mails and the audit log of sensitive actions, with no names.

purposes.title: Why, and on what basis
paragraphs: We use this data to:
items: provide the service you ask for: account, events, albums, payments, e-mails related to your event (performance of the contract);
protect the service against abuse and bots, and follow its errors (legitimate interest);
tell a guest when the album is ready (separate consent, which can be withdrawn at any time);
measure the site’s audience, only if you accept it in the cookie banner (consent);
meet our accounting and legal obligations (legal obligation).

recipients.title: Who receives your data
paragraphs: We use providers that process data on our behalf:
items: Supabase: database and authentication;
Cloudflare: storage of photos and videos (R2) and anti-bot check (Turnstile);
Vercel: hosting of the site;
Stripe: payments;
Resend: sending e-mails;
Upstash: limiting the number of requests;
Sentry: error tracking;
Google: sign-in with Google, if you choose it;
PostHog: audience measurement, after your consent.

transfers.title: Location and transfers
paragraphs: We aim to host data in the European Union. Some providers (Stripe, Google, Vercel, Sentry) may process data outside the Union; such transfers are covered by standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision. [To be completed before opening: exact region of each provider, see the record of processing activities.]

retention.title: How long
paragraphs: We keep data:
items: photos, videos, guests and settings of an event: according to the plan ({freeDays} days after the event on the free plan, {eventMonths} months on the Event plan), then permanent deletion within seven days;
e-mail addresses left by guests to be notified: erased when the event expires;
organiser account: as long as the account exists; its deletion takes effect seven days after the request;
purchases: for as long as accounting obligations require, even after the event is deleted;
sign-in token: 1 hour; IP address fingerprint: 15 minutes.

rights.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask for access to your data, its correction, its erasure, its portability, the restriction of processing, or object to it, and withdraw a consent at any time.

An organiser can export their account data and delete their account from the “My account” page. A guest can delete their photos from “My photos” and remove their e-mail address from the event page. For any other request, write to {contact}.
You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).

security.title: Security
paragraphs: Traffic is encrypted (HTTPS). Access to data is limited by security rules at database level, files are served through temporary signed addresses and do not pass through our application servers, and sensitive keys are only used on the server side.
No system is infallible: if a data breach is likely to put you at risk, we will tell you and the competent authority, as the law requires.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This policy may change; the date of the last update is at the top of the page.

cookies.metaDescription: The cookies and local storage used by {appName}, and how to choose.
cookies.title: Cookie policy

what.title: What we are talking about
paragraphs: A cookie, or local browser storage, is a small file saved on your device. Some are needed for the service to work; others measure the audience and are only used with your consent.

essential.title: What is necessary, with no consent
paragraphs: These items are not used to track you and do not require consent:
items: the session of the signed-in organiser and that of the guest (anonymous identifier created when joining);
the chosen language;
your choice in the cookie banner;
on the guest’s device, the queue of photos to upload and a flag that lets the upload resume (local storage and IndexedDB);
the Cloudflare Turnstile anti-bot check on the sign-in page.

analytics.title: Audience measurement, with your consent
paragraphs: To understand how the site is used and improve it, we may use PostHog (hosted in the European Union). It is only loaded after you accept and is not used on an event’s guest page. Refusing is as easy as accepting, and the service works the same way.

choice.title: Choosing and changing your mind
paragraphs: Your choice is saved on your device. You can change it at any time with the “Manage cookies” link at the bottom of every page, or by clearing the site’s data in your browser.

errors.title: Error tracking
paragraphs: Technical errors may be sent to Sentry so that we can fix them. This does not use a cookie and contains no personal data.
